description: This file defines a ProseMirror selection subclass called CellSelection for modeling table cell selections, including methods for mapping, content extraction, replacement, and serialization, as well as utility functions for selection normalization and drawing.

classes.name: CellSelection
classes.description: A subclass of ProseMirror Selection representing a selection of table cells, with methods for mapping, content extraction, replacement, and serialization.

classes.name: CellBookmark
classes.description: A class representing a bookmark for a cell selection, used for restoring selections.

methods.name: CellSelection.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a cell selection given anchor and head positions within a table.

methods.name: CellSelection.map
methods.description: Maps the selection through document changes, maintaining selection consistency.

methods.name: CellSelection.content
methods.description: Returns a slice of the table containing the selected cells.

methods.name: CellSelection.replace
methods.description: Replaces the selected cells with provided content.

methods.name: CellSelection.replaceWith
methods.description: Replaces the selection with a specific node.

methods.name: CellSelection.forEachCell
methods.description: Iterates over each cell in the selection, applying a callback.

methods.name: CellSelection.isColSelection
methods.description: Checks if the selection spans entire columns.

methods.name: CellSelection.isRowSelection
methods.description: Checks if the selection spans entire rows.

methods.name: CellSelection.eq
methods.description: Checks equality with another selection.

methods.name: CellSelection.colSelection
methods.description: Creates a column selection between two cells.

methods.name: CellSelection.rowSelection
methods.description: Creates a row selection between two cells.

methods.name: CellSelection.toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the selection to JSON.

methods.name: CellSelection.fromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON to a CellSelection.

methods.name: CellSelection.create
methods.description: Creates a new CellSelection from document and positions.

methods.name: CellSelection.getBookmark
methods.description: Returns a bookmark for the current selection.

methods.name: CellBookmark.map
methods.description: Maps the bookmark through document changes.

methods.name: CellBookmark.resolve
methods.description: Resolves the bookmark back into a selection.

methods.name: drawCellSelection
methods.description: Creates decorations to visually highlight selected cells.

methods.name: isCellBoundarySelection
methods.description: Checks if a text selection is at a cell boundary.

methods.name: isTextSelectionAcrossCells
methods.description: Checks if a text selection spans across different cells.

methods.name: normalizeSelection
methods.description: Normalizes various selection types into cell or row selections when appropriate.
